productionRule: QB adjustment is expected current QB value minus the QB value embedded in the 2025 team baseline, scaled by participation/health/scenario probability. Full PAR is never added on top of the team rating.

states.reason: Mahomes is progressing toward Week 1 after ACL/LCL surgery, but the production delta requires explicit expected mobility/health versus his 2025 embedded state.
Competition remains open; Tua is starting the preseason finale while Penix has only recently returned to full 11-on-11 work.
Jones is fully participating in camp and no longer warrants the prior heavy Achilles availability discount; only a small recovery uncertainty band remains until Week 1 practice reports.

Miami released Tua and signed Willis as the new starter. Willis does not have a qualifying calibrated historical sample in the current QB dataset, so the downgrade is real but must be estimated with a small-sample prior rather than invented precision.

Todd Monken has not named a starter. Neither candidate has a defensible current calibrated value in the production QB dataset, so Cleveland remains scenario-blocked rather than assigned an arbitrary downgrade.
Rodgers is Pittsburgh's established 2026 starter under Mike McCarthy; final delta will compare him with Pittsburgh's 2025 embedded QB state rather than adding 0.49 points directly.
New York is using Geno Smith as its immediate bridge starter while developing Cade Klubnik. Final QB adjustment waits for the 2025 embedded Jets QB baseline comparison.
